class.name: OcgIgescontrolIgesboundary
class.brief_description: Translates IGES boundary entity (types 141, 142 and 508) in Advanced Data Exchange. Redefines translation and treatment methods from inherited open class IGESToBRep_IGESBoundary.
class.description: ! Translates IGES boundary entity (types 141, 142 and 508) ! in Advanced Data Exchange. ! Redefines translation and treatment methods from inherited ! open class IGESToBRep_IGESBoundary.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates an object and calls inherited constructor.

method.name: Check
method.description: Checks result of translation of IGES boundary entities (types 141, 142 or 508). Checks consistency of 2D and 3D representations and keeps only one if they are inconsistent. Checks the closure of resulting wire and if it is not closed, checks 2D and 3D representation and updates the resulting wire to contain only closed representation.
